scaling.description: Qubits and transpiled depth vs problem size (key bits / modulus).

noise.description: Attack success probability vs noise level, plus fake IBM backend runs.

iteration_curve.description: Measured success vs Grover iterations, with the theoretical sin² envelope.

success_rate.description: Attack success rate across keys/seeds and conditions (and Shor per base a).

comparison.description: Quantum oracle calls / circuit runs vs classical tries, per problem size.

counting.description: Quantum-counting estimate of the number of matching keys vs the true count.

bb84_qber_vs_eve.description: BB84: measured QBER vs Eve's intercept fraction, with the theory fraction/4 and the abort threshold.

bb84_qber_vs_noise.description: BB84: measured QBER vs channel noise, with the 11% abort threshold.

bb84_key_rate.description: BB84: key bits per raw qubit by raw qubits and channel noise. key_rate = delivered key (always 256 bits, 0 when aborted) / raw; secure_rate = estimated extractable secret bits / raw.

defence_overhead.description: AES-256 / ML-KEM-768 / BB84: measured sizes and timings by message length.
